# Distributed Lock Manager (DLM) & Fencing Tokens

Distributed synchronization using fencing tokens: monotonically increasing counters to invalidate split-brain writes from delayed clients.

## Invariants
- PASS_MONOTONIC_FENCING_TOKEN_TO_STORAGE
- STORAGE_REJECTS_WRITES_WITH_STALE_FENCING_TOKENS
- LOCK_HEARTBEAT_RENEWAL
